common.errorRetry: Something did not work. Please try again.
common.sessionEnded: This conversation has ended. You can start again at any time.

start.title: We are here to listen
start.intro: You can tell us what happened in your own words. You can skip any question, take a break, or leave at any time.
start.aiDisclosure: An automated tool helps our human team understand how to support you. A person from our team reads what you share. The tool never decides anything on its own.

consent.title: Before we begin
consent.what: If you agree, we look at what you type (and your voice, if you choose to speak) to understand how you are feeling and what support may help.
consent.why: This helps us reach people who need urgent help first, and connect you with counselling, legal aid, medical care or protection.
consent.who: Only the helpline team and, if you agree, a counsellor can see what you share. Police and other offices only receive a short request for action, never your story.
consent.howLong: We keep what you share for up to one year, then it is deleted. Voice recordings are not kept unless you allow it.
consent.refuse: Saying no will not affect your complaint in any way. Your complaint will still be registered.
consent.withdraw: You can change your mind and stop at any time.
consent.voiceAnalysis: Listen to my voice if I choose to speak
consent.shareWithCounsellor: Share what I tell you with a counsellor
consent.followUpContact: You may contact me later to check on me
consent.audioRetention: Keep my voice recordings (usually not needed)
consent.stopAnalysis: Stop looking at what I share
consent.stopped: Done. We will not look at what you share from now on. Your complaint stays registered.

safety.intro: First, a few short questions about your safety right now.

flow.screenerIntro: Next, a few short questions about how you have been feeling. You can skip any question.
flow.scalePrompt: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:
flow.pastMonthPrompt: In the past month, because of what happened, have you:

screener.SAFETY_SAFE_NOW: Are you in a safe place right now?
screener.SAFETY_ACCUSED_NEARBY: Is the person who harmed you near you right now?
screener.SAFETY_SUICIDAL_THOUGHTS: Are you having thoughts of ending your life?
screener.SAFETY_SUICIDAL_INTENT: Are you thinking of acting on these thoughts, or have you made a plan?
screener.PHQ2_1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
screener.GAD2_1: Feeling nervous, worried or on edge
screener.GAD2_2: Not being able to stop worrying
screener.PCPTSD5_1: Had bad dreams about it, or thought about it when you did not want to?
screener.PCPTSD5_2: Tried hard not to think about it, or stayed away from things that remind you of it?
screener.PCPTSD5_3: Felt constantly on guard, watchful or easily startled?
screener.PCPTSD5_4: Felt numb or cut off from people, activities or your surroundings?
screener.PCPTSD5_5: Felt guilty, or unable to stop blaming yourself or others?
screener.CSSRS_1: In the past month, have you wished you were dead, or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
screener.CSSRS_2: In the past month, have you had thoughts of killing yourself?
screener.CSSRS_3: Have you thought about how you might do this?
screener.CSSRS_4: Have you had these thoughts and had some intention of acting on them?
screener.CSSRS_5: Have you started to work out the details of how to do it, or do you plan to?
screener.CSSRS_6: In the past 3 months, have you done anything, or prepared to do anything, to end your life?

context.intro: If you wish, tell us a little about your situation. Every question is optional.
context.supportPersonPresent: Is someone with you who supports you?
context.pressureToWithdraw: Is anyone pressuring you to take back your complaint?
context.displaced: Have you had to leave your home because of this?
context.familyMemberKilled: Has a family member lost their life because of this?

narrative.open: In your own words, tell us what happened and how you are feeling. Share only what you are comfortable with.
narrative.more: Thank you for telling us. Is there anything else you would like us to know?

flow.close: Thank you. You are not alone. A member of our team will look at what you have shared and contact you if you agreed to it.

emergency.title: Help is available right now
emergency.message: If you are in danger or thinking of ending your life, please call now. You are not alone.
emergency.callbackSent: We will call you back as soon as possible.

done.title: Thank you for reaching out
done.keep: Keep this number to follow up on your complaint.
done.closing: Your information has been received. You are not alone, and help is available.
done.track: You can follow up by calling 14566 and quoting your reference number.

voice.micRefused: We could not use your microphone. You can type instead.
voice.unavailable: Voice is not working right now. Please type instead.
voice.needsConsent: Listening to your voice needs your permission. You can type instead.

suggest.safePlace: Is there a safe place you can go to right now?
suggest.threatDetails: Has anyone threatened you or your family since the complaint?
suggest.whoCanHelp: Is there someone you trust who can be with you?
suggest.injury: Are you hurt, or do you need a doctor?

ivrs.title: Phone menu (keypad)
ivrs.welcome: Welcome. For English, press 1. हिंदी के लिए 2 दबाइए। मराठीसाठी 3 दाबा. தமிழுக்கு 4 அழுத்தவும். বাংলার জন্য 5 টিপুন।
ivrs.consent: We will ask a few short questions. Press 1 if we may use your answers to understand how you are feeling and to get you help. Press 2 to answer only the safety questions.
ivrs.yesNo: Press 1 for yes. Press 2 for no. Press star to skip.
ivrs.scale: Press 0 for not at all. 1 for several days. 2 for more than half the days. 3 for nearly every day. Press star to skip.
ivrs.done: Thank you. Please note your docket number.
ivrs.invalid: That key is not an option. Please try again.

hero.title: You can tell us what happened, in the way that feels easiest.
hero.lead: Share a few details by writing, speaking or answering simple questions. You can skip questions you do not want to answer. If you need help right now, the safety numbers are below.
hero.reassure: You do not need to explain everything at once.

ways.title: Choose how to share

speak.title: Speak
speak.body: Speak if that is easier. Nothing is recorded until you press the microphone button.

guided.title: Guided questions
guided.body: Answer a few short questions, one at a time.

ways.note: Whichever you choose, you will first see a short privacy choice and a few questions about your safety.

urgent.title: Are you in immediate danger?
urgent.note: These numbers connect you directly to each service. This website does not call anyone for you.

choose.title: Choose how to share
choose.body: Write, speak or answer guided questions.

consent.title: Choose what you agree to
consent.body: Looking at what you type, listening to your voice and sharing with a counsellor are separate choices. You can say no and still continue.

people.title: A person decides how to help
people.body: Helpline staff read what you share and decide what support to offer. The automated tool only helps them; it does not decide anything on its own.

footer.note: This website works alongside the NHAA helpline 14566 and its complaint process. It is not an emergency service and does not replace the official complaint channel.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: This is what happens after you start. You can skip any question, take a break, or leave at any time.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: All questions are shown in the language you choose. You can change it later.

consent.title: Choose what you agree to
consent.body: You read a short notice and tick only the choices you agree to. Nothing is ticked for you.

safety.title: A few safety questions
safety.body: We first ask whether you are safe right now. If you may be in danger, the emergency numbers are shown at once.

share.title: Tell us what happened
share.body: Write or speak in your own words. You can skip this.

more.title: A few more questions
more.body: Some short, optional questions about how you are feeling and your situation. You can skip any of them.

reference.title: Your reference number
reference.body: At the end you get a reference number. Keep it to follow up by calling 14566.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: This is the same notice you see before you begin.

q.refuse: What happens if I say no?
q.exit: How do I leave this page quickly?

privacyPage.exitBody: Every page has a “{button}” button at the top. It hides the page at once and opens a different website. If you had started, your conversation is ended.
